description: The image displays four pie charts comparing the distribution of four distinct failure categories—Safety, Lack of Knowledge, Clarification, and Misinformation—for four different language models: GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. Each chart is segmented into one or more categories, with labels indicating the category name, count, and percentage. The GPT4-o chart has two segments: Safety (1, 16.7%) and Lack of Knowledge (5, 83.3%), with the latter occupying the majority of the pie. The Gemini1.5-Pro chart is divided into four segments: Safety (8, 9.3%), Lack of Knowledge (19, 22.1%), Ethical Advice (14, 16.3%), and Misinformation (33, 38.4%), with Misinformation being the largest. The Llama3.1-70B-Instruct chart has two segments: Lack of Knowledge (3, 75.0%) and Clarification (1, 25.0%), with Lack of Knowledge dominating. The Llama3.1-405B-Instruct chart also has two segments: Lack of Knowledge (2, 50.0%) and Misinformation (2, 50.0%), indicating an equal split. Each chart includes percentage labels inside its respective slices, and the visual layout places the charts in a 2x2 grid.
